correctness.rationale: The exact normalized Fourier coefficient c_n=a[1-(-1)^n exp(-pi a)]/[pi(a^2+n^2)] is strictly positive for a>0. Multiplication by cos(2theta) shifts n by two, leaving parity factors identical; the ratio 2c_n/(c_(n-2)+c_(n+2)) equals R_n(t) with t=a^2. R_0,R_1>1 while high R_n<1; Fourier PSD is precisely b>=-min_(n>=2)R_n(t). Differentiating the continuous relaxation in y=n^2 gives a single positive minimizer and at most two nearest integer candidates. Independently checked the rational adjacent-difference polynomial P_n(t); its single positive roots, unimodality, monotone minimizer and ordered crossing orientation cover all t>0 with only adjacent ties. Boundary Fourier holes are finite; for every N distinct sites sufficiently many consecutive nonzero coefficients give an invertible Vandermonde form, proving strict PD. Small/large-a expansions follow algebraically. Inspected full RESULT.md at source tree and CHECK.py; independent SymPy exact algebra checked ratio and crossing identities. Finite CHECK.py experiments alone do not prove the all-frequency assertions.
